name: smwgraphics-pok-mon-gold-silver-intro-underwater
title: Pokémon Gold/Silver - Intro (Underwater)
description:
A rip of the underwater part of the intro scene in Pokémon Gold/Silver.

Note that the background doesn't loop horizontally or vertically, however due to the nature of the tiles, it's easy to "expand" it vertically to "fit" the 16x14 size (a sample level was provided for this).
